title: Sovereign Ingestion
style:
Style / Genre: Canadian Alternative Roots Rock / Poetic Spoken-Word Rock

Tempo & Meter: 108 BPM, 4/4 time (with an expansive, unhurried backbeat)

Vocal Style: Passionate mid-range baritone, gravelly and conversational, transitioning into soaring, strained melodic cries and intimate spoken-word poetry.

Part 1: Structural & Compositional Breakdown
1. Intro (0:00 – 0:45) — The Northern Swell
Instrumentation: A lone, open-tuned acoustic guitar strumming a persistent eighth-note rhythm, joined by ambient electric guitar swells drenched in spring reverb and a low, resonant drone.

Thematic Function: Establishes the vantage point from "afar." The sound mimics a cold northern wind blowing across an empty stage or a quiet lake, bridging the gap between the mortal world and the afterlife.

2. Verse 1 & 2 (0:45 – 2:15) — The Night the Nation Stopped
lyrics:
The Song: "Sovereign Ingestion"
(To the beat of a fast, hypnotic cyberpunk/industrial synth line)

(Verse 1)
Hit the terminal, raw text on the glass,
Scrape the registry, filter out the trash.
Point-five-six-six, but the signal didn't show,
bae.fyi belongs to someone else from long ago.
Look at the markup, look at the screen,
Premium prices clogging up the machine.
A thousand for a .pro, a trap in the code,
We don't pay the gatekeepers to carry the load.

(Chorus)
Pull the sniper trigger, drop it in the tray,
We run the data lines a completely different way.
Isolate the telemetry, route it through the dark,
Lock down the asset, leave a sovereign mark.

(Verse 2)
So bypass the color tricks, drop the gold hype,
We match the infrastructure to the architecture type.
bae.locker sits open on the bottom of the page,
A low-cost container for the digital age.
Ingest the IP metadata, map out the grid,
Keep the pipeline hidden where the reference system lived.
No corporate fluff, no bloated design,
Just raw automation running clean down the line.

(Chorus)
Pull the sniper trigger, drop it in the tray,
We run the data lines a completely different way.
Isolate the telemetry, route it through the dark,
Lock down the asset, leave a sovereign mark.
